relations.statement: HasRawQuartet H iff there exist U V with RayBasis H U, RayBasis H V and RawMU U V
If no two common rays z,w of H have normSq(overlap z w) = 6 then H has no raw quartet

lemmas.statement: For raw Hadamard H, HasRawQuartet H iff two common-ray bases U,V of I and H are raw-unbiased
lemmas.lean_skeleton: example (H : MUB.SzollosiCommonRays.SixMatrix) (hH : MUB.SzollosiCommonRays.RawHadamard H) : MUB.SzollosiCommonRays.HasRawQuartet H ↔ ∃ U V, MUB.SzollosiCommonRays.RayBasis H U ∧ MUB.SzollosiCommonRays.RayBasis H V ∧ MUB.SzollosiCommonRays.RawMU U V := MUB.SzollosiCommonRays.quartet_iff_ray_bases H hH

lemmas.statement: If no common rays z,w have normSq overlap = 6 then no raw quartet
lemmas.lean_skeleton: example (H : MUB.SzollosiCommonRays.SixMatrix) (h : ∀ z w, MUB.SzollosiCommonRays.CommonRay H z → MUB.SzollosiCommonRays.CommonRay H w → Complex.normSq (MUB.SzollosiCommonRays.overlap z w) ≠ 6) : ¬ MUB.SzollosiCommonRays.HasRawQuartet H := MUB.SzollosiCommonRays.no_quartet_of_no_unbiased_ray_pair H h

near_misses.claim: Treating a bound on ||<z,w>|^2-6| at the Szollosi point as a proof of exclusion for all H
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Only one special point is covered; the full common-ray set per H is not computed (KNOWN- vacuous_proof)

open_obligations: Full common-ray set for general H is not computed; exclusion beyond MUB6-C41 is open
Skeleton type names RawHadamard and HasRawQuartet and RawMU not confirmed in SRC namespace, so elaboration is unverified
